english.title: Goods vehicle - fail to notify conviction of transport manager

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: GOODS VEHICLES LICENSING OF OPERATORS ACT 1995

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) having made an application for a standard licence and having included particulars of a transport manager, knowingly failed to notify the Traffic Commissioner to whom the application was made that the transport manager had been convicted of **(..SPECIFY OFFENCE FROM LIST IN PARAGRAPH 5 OF SCHEDULE 2..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 9(3)(b) of the Goods Vehicles (Licensing of Operators) Act 1995.

english.notes:
(i) Section 51 provides an extended time limit for bringing proceedings by applying section 6 of the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988 to this offence.
(ii) Statement of facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant, who had made an application for a standard licence which included details of a transport manager, failed to notify the Traffic Commissioner that the transport manager had been convicted of an offence in interval between the making of the application and the date of its disposal. On **(..SPECIFY DATE OF CONVICTION..) **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), the transport manager, was convicted of **(..SPECIFY OFFENCE(S)..).
